fact: The same report says work continued to operationalise an open data portal and that staff reviewed it and gave input for further development; it names no publishing bodies or dataset count, the ministry's report does not say who runs the portal beyond the ministry's own activity, and it does not tie the portal to the draft policy.

A mapping report presented on 13 November 2025 says Uganda publishes machine-readable procurement data on the Government Procurement Portal run by the PPDA, with 26 of 148 OC4IDS data elements published (17.6%).

The Data Technical Working Group chaired by the Uganda Bureau of Statistics reported that all 155 reported SDG indicators and their metadata have been uploaded to the National SDG Open Data Portal, of 201 SDG indicators.

CoST Uganda says that since July 2025 a project with the PPDA has worked to reverse the decline in infrastructure data disclosures on the Government Procurement Portal and to upgrade it; the date is the document's publication date.
UBOS states it maintains public data portals including NSO Open Data, a Spatial Data Portal and a Gender Statistics Portal.
The Office of the Prime Minister's SDG Secretariat says the Uganda Bureau of Statistics hosts the SDG Open Data Portal, where users can download datasets of Uganda's official SDG indicators.

The Open Contracting Partnership registry says Uganda's procurement authority PPDA publishes open contracting datasets from July 2015 to October 2026, updated monthly and downloadable as JSON, Excel or CSV.

The Open Contracting Partnership registry states that PPDA's open contracting datasets in Uganda carry the Open Data Commons Attribution License, which lets anyone share, adapt and build on the data with attribution.
